clauses.text:
I hereby establish the following
order for the Canal Zone:
Section I. It shall be unlawful for any person to operate an aeroplane,
balloon or living machine of any kind in or across the Canal Zone without
the written authority of the Chief Executive of the Canal Zone.
Section 2 It shall be unlawful for any, person to take or make a
photograph, picture or sketch of any kind of the fortifications or other
military works in the Canal Zone from any aeroplane, balloon or flying
machine of any kind without the written consent of the Chief Executive
of the Canal Zone.

clauses.label: Section 3.

source.page_or_item: ProQuest Congressional Replica of Original, file PT1-1913-EO-1810.pdf (1 pages)

clauses.text:
Section 3. A violation of any of the provisions of this order shall be
punishable by a fine not exceeding One Thousand dollars or by imprison-
ment in jail not exceeding one year, or by both such fine and imprisonment
in the discretion of the Court.

clauses.label: Section 4.

source.page_or_item: ProQuest Congressional Replica of Original, file PT1-1913-EO-1810.pdf (1 pages)

clauses.text:
Section 4. This order shall take effect on and after thirty days from
its publication in the Canal Record.

ORIGINAL:EO:1810.text:
Executive Orber,
To prohibit the unauthorized use of flying machines.
By' virtue of the authority vested in me, I hereby establish the following
order for the Canal Zone:
Section I. It shall be unlawful for any person to operate an aeroplane,
balloon or living machine of any kind in or across the Canal Zone without
the written authority of the Chief Executive of the Canal Zone.
Section 2 It shall be unlawful for any, person to take or make a
photograph, picture or sketch of any kind of the fortifications or other
military works in the Canal Zone from any aeroplane, balloon or flying
machine of any kind without the written consent of the Chief Executive
of the Canal Zone.
Section 3. A violation of any of the provisions of this order shall be
punishable by a fine not exceeding One Thousand dollars or by imprison-
ment in jail not exceeding one year, or by both such fine and imprisonment
in the discretion of the Court.
Section 4. This order shall take effect on and after thirty days from
its publication in the Canal Record.
WOODROW WILSON
THE WHITE HOUSE,
7 A ugis/, 1913.
